exposure: Time period (pre- and post-introduction of early-term delivery guidelines in 2006)
Gestational age at birth (34-36 weeks, 37-38 weeks, and 39-42 weeks)
cohort: This study included 193,136 singleton births to primiparous women in Western Australia between 1995 and 2010.
finding: The rise in Cesarean delivery rates in Western Australia between 1995 and 2010 was primarily driven by an increase in pre-labor Cesarean deliveries at 37-38 weeks gestation, which subsequently declined after the introduction of early-term delivery guidelines in 2006.
